title: Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds
summary: We prove that every maximal ordinary negative-ray program starting from a compact Kähler klt fourfold pair with effective rational boundary in the global Weil-divisor ℚ-factorial category terminates. It ends at a nef model when the adjoint is pseudo-effective and at a projective Mori fibre space otherwise.
family_title: Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs

review.reason: Proves termination of maximal ordinary negative-ray programs on compact Kähler klt fourfolds.
